caption_en: decomineral style, flat mineral pigments, no chiaroscuro, tapestry space, closed color shapes, three sacred figures standing in a row of arched niches behind a patterned balcony railing, one playing a lute, one dancing with raised arms, round halos and fluttering ribbons, malachite green, cinnabar red, azurite blue, ochre, jade white
notes_zh: 西魏天宫伎乐横带：三身天人立拱龛，栏楯纹带，左弹琵琶右起舞。
